row.title: Shelved Q-AUDIT items count as accounted; no duplicate test basenames
row.body: failure_audit --check and DISPOSE-1 disagreed: dispose shelves an open Q-AUDIT item after its TTL while the audit demanded an open one, so main failed test_failure_audit. A shelved or gate disposition now counts (its probe keeps running). The executor-added tests/test_mergeaudit.py duplicated a basename and called gh live; replaced by tests/test_mergeaudit_offline.py.
